seo.title: Founding Member | Early Access & Exclusive Benefits | KLUB Limassol
seo.description: Join the KLUB founding member list before our September 2026 Limassol opening. Founding members get a free week of unlimited Pilates and 20% off their first package.

hero.heading: Be Part of the Founding Circle
hero.intro: Be among the first to experience KLUB before our official opening. As a founding member you'll receive exclusive early-access benefits that welcome you into the community from day one — be part of something exceptional from the very beginning.

perks.strong: One free week of unlimited Pilates
perks.rest: move without limits — unlimited access to every class in your first week, so you can experience all of KLUB.
a thank-you for joining early: 20% off your first membership or class package.
choose your class times before slots open to anyone else.
location, hours and every announcement before they're public.

scarcity: A limited opportunity — founding-member benefits are available to a select number of members only, and registration is open until 25 August 2026. Once we reach capacity or that date passes, early access closes for good.
formNote: We never share your details. You'll receive a couple of emails before opening, then only our weekly timetable — unsubscribe anytime.
